title: BAB Online socket contract
$comment: GENERATED by npm run contract:gen from contract/src. Wire changes are additive only until the v1 removals (contract/V1_REMOVALS.md).

inMs.description: ms the server still holds the table, from serverTime (relative: never compare with a client clock)

signUp.notes: Two per-socket budgets. The wrapper limit rateLimiter.signUp (20 / 5 min) counts every attempt and over it replies error {type:'rateLimit'}. Refusals by the new-name rules, the profanity filter and the taken check spend only that; an attempt past them (bcrypt hash + insert) also spends rateLimiter.signUpAccount (3 / 5 min), checked in-handler, and over it gets signUpResponse {success:false, message}.

clientHello.notes: Sent on every connect by clients that read avatarUrl / avatarUrls ($defs.clientCap). No reply. Absent = legacy shape (the App Store iOS build, cached old web bundles). Unknown caps are ignored; the last hello wins (one without avatarUrl downgrades the socket). Over the rate limit it is dropped silently. Logged with the client version (telemetry for V1_REMOVALS).

joinQueue.notes: Registered with safeHandler (no Joi, no rate limit). V1_REMOVALS #2.

addBot.notes: The handler ignores the payload; iOS sends {personality}.

removeBot.notes: iOS LobbyEmitter.removeBot sends no payload (the server answers error). No Joi schema yet.

playerBid.notes: Web sends a string; iOS an Int for numeric bids and a string for bores. 13 / '13' passes Joi (both clients offer 0...hand size) and is refused by the handler (actionRejected invalid_bid) unless the hand has 13 cards.

requestSnapshot.notes: New in snapshot v2 (no shipped iOS client sends it yet). Answered by stateSnapshot to this socket only. Web always sends {requestId, customPics:false, log:false}: "ping-*" its liveness ping after the tab was hidden > 5 s (item 15; a reconnect only when no reply arrives), "gap-*" on a seq gap (debounced: one in flight), "ack-*" when its bid/play got no answer for 5 s (item 16); every reply with a snapshot of its table is applied and rendered.

uploadProfilePic.notes: Pipeline on (docs/avatars.md): decoded and re-encoded server-side; stored as a WebP data URL <= 256 px; undecodable or unsafe images are refused with the usual {success:false, message}.

getLeaderboard.notes: Throttled in-handler (rateLimiter key getLeaderboard); over the limit replies leaderboardResponse with the cached (possibly stale) result, else the fill in flight, else the existing {success:false, message} reply; never error. Served from a 60 s cache invalidated on stats/picture/account changes.

getRecords.notes: Throttled in-handler (rateLimiter key getRecords); over the limit replies recordsResponse with the cached (possibly stale) result, else the fill in flight, else the existing {success:false, message} reply; never error. Served from a 60 s cache (per month) invalidated when a game is recorded or an account deleted.

searchPlayers.notes: asyncHandler("searchPlayers") but validators has no schema: passes through with a warning. A trimmed query longer than 50 (the username max) short-circuits to an empty list in the handler.

getPlayerProfile.notes: No Joi schema yet (passes through with a warning).

voiceOffer.notes: Forwarded only to a connected socket id (never a room) of a signed-in peer in the sender's lobby or game (entrant / seat owner; not a pure spectator), when neither user blocked the other, within the per-socket limit rateLimiter.voiceOffer (30 / 10 s), checked in-handler; anything else is dropped silently (no reply, never error).

voiceAnswer.notes: Forwarded only to a connected socket id (never a room) of a signed-in peer in the sender's lobby or game (entrant / seat owner; not a pure spectator), when neither user blocked the other, within the per-socket limit rateLimiter.voiceAnswer (30 / 10 s), checked in-handler; anything else is dropped silently (no reply, never error).

voiceIceCandidate.notes: Forwarded only to a connected socket id (never a room) of a signed-in peer in the sender's lobby or game (entrant / seat owner; not a pure spectator), when neither user blocked the other, within the per-socket limit rateLimiter.voiceIceCandidate (300 / 10 s), checked in-handler; anything else is dropped silently (no reply, never error).

voiceRelayAudio.notes: Forwarded only to a connected socket id (never a room) of a signed-in peer in the sender's lobby or game (entrant / seat owner; not a pure spectator), when neither user blocked the other, within the per-socket limit rateLimiter.voiceRelayAudio (1200 / 10 s), checked in-handler; anything else is dropped silently (no reply, never error). The web PCM fallback after a failed P2P connection. Only binary audio is forwarded (the web client emits an Int16Array's ArrayBuffer; the server receives a Buffer): non-empty, an even byte count, at most 64 KB. A string, array, number or plain object is dropped (the web receiver decodes with new Int16Array, which reads those as a sample count). No current web bundle sends it (TURN replaced it, 2026-11-11); the handler stays for web bundles cached before that deploy (V1_REMOVALS #20).

getVoiceIceServers.notes: Answered by voiceIceServers to this socket only (requestId echoed). Web asks before its first peer connection of a voice session and again before the credentials expire. TURN credentials (Cloudflare Realtime, minted server-side, cached per user) only for a signed-in socket that is a voice peer now (in a lobby, or an entrant / seat owner of a game); everyone else, and every failure (env unset, Cloudflare timeout or error), gets the public STUN servers. iOS 1.1.0 does not send it (it hard-codes STUN); the next iOS release will (V1_REMOVALS "iOS TURN").

adminRequest.notes: The admin panel (server/socket/adminHandlers.js). Answered by adminResponse to this socket only (requestId and action echoed). Authorized on EVERY request against the database (signed in, the account's current socket, its session still live, not a merged tombstone, isAdmin true); anyone else gets {ok:false, error:'forbidden'} for every action and target, before args are read, so a non-admin learns nothing. args are validated per action after that (adminHandlers ACTION_SCHEMAS; invalid -> {ok:false, error:'invalid'}). Each request writes one adminAudit entry (listAudit excepted). Wrapper limit 60/min (error {type:'rateLimit'}).

signInResponse.notes: isAdmin (additive, 2026-11-11; present only when true): the web menu shows its Admin entry. Display only: the server re-checks the database on every adminRequest. iOS 1.1.0 reads the reply as a dictionary and ignores the key.

restoreSessionResponse.notes: isAdmin: as on signInResponse (display only, present only when true; iOS 1.1.0 ignores it).

activeGameFound.notes: Never emitted (signInResponse.activeGameId replaced it). CAUTION: the only event that makes the shipped iOS app emit rejoinGame by itself (AuthSocketHandler.handleActiveGameFound); see V1_REMOVALS.md.

blockListUpdated.notes: Also sent unasked (success, with silent: true) to a player whose saved block list an admin RENAME re-pointed (accountDelete.refreshBlockLists), so the renamed player's chat stays hidden; both clients replace their list. Web shows its "Block list updated" info toast only without silent. The App Store iOS build (1.1.0, f05d264) ignores silent and shows its "Block list updated." alert (SafetySocketHandler / .safetyAlerts) wherever the player is: accepted for renames, which are rare and owner-run. An admin DELETE sends nothing (the dead name stays in the client list, harmless, until the next sign-in; only the voice list is refreshed), and a player's own Delete account leaves other players' lists alone.

mainRoomJoined.notes: recentMessages duplicates messages (iOS reads recentMessages first).

mainRoomPlayerJoined.notes: socket.to(mainRoom): everyone in the main room but the joiner.

mainRoomPlayerLeft.notes: New: the user's last socket disconnected (the online list shrank). Counterpart of mainRoomPlayerJoined. A sign-out that keeps the socket open is not covered. Current builds ignore it and keep a stale count (ctr-21).

stateSnapshot.notes: New in snapshot v2: the reply to requestSnapshot. The log is included unless the request sends log:false; custom (data-URL) seat pictures only with customPics:true (partial lists what was left out). notInGame: the socket is in no live game - also once its game ENDED or ABORTED (the terminal state arrives as gameEnd / abortGame, never as a snapshot).

playerActiveMode.notes: One room broadcast: pic is the legacy value (the small inline WebP for a custom picture); avatarUrl (additive, only with a rendition) is preferred by capable clients.

spectatorJoined.notes: fullState goes to the joining socket only (socket.emit), BEFORE the room notice. The notice reaches the joiner too (ctr-17; V1_REMOVALS #8). trumpBroken / teamTricks / oppTricks switch on reads the App Store iOS build already has in restoreFromSpectator (since Feb 2026): its spectator view CHANGES visibly, knowingly, as a fix (real trump-broken state and trick counts instead of false and 0-0). leadPosition is read only by iOS source builds after 10d1538 (the App Store build infers the lead from the first card). ctr-1, ctr-8, ios-8d; web reads none of them.

spectatorsUpdated.notes: Who is watching (owner, 2026-11-11: the table's spectator badge), the WHOLE list each time: GameState.spectatorList() (pure spectators, one per username in join order, never a seat owner or entrant), at most 50 entries, count the true total (the same as snapshot v2 `watching`; the older spectatorCount fields stay the spectator SOCKET count, cc865b4's meaning). Sent to the game room on every change (join, leave, disconnect, spectating another game, a round start, a reclaim), coalesced to one emit per game per 250 ms, skipped when unchanged, never after end/abort. UNSEQUENCED (no seq, no bump; GameState.emitUnsequenced): an absolute display state, and the App Store build (f05d264) registers no handler for it, so a sequenced form would open a gap in its seq gate on every change. The snapshot's `watching` carries the same {spectators, count}. iOS reads nothing yet (V1_REMOVALS "iOS spectator badge").

leaderboardResponse.notes: Rows by recipient (docs/avatars.md): a capable socket gets customProfilePic null + avatarUrls {username: url}; a legacy one the small inline rendition. The App Store iOS build reads neither.

tournamentPlayerJoined.notes: scoreboard (additive, 2026-11-11): the whole sorted scoreboard, the joiner's new row included; web redraws the lobby's table from it, iOS 1.1.0 reads only players.

tournamentPlayerLeft.notes: username is absent when the leaver had no registered user (user?.username).

adminResponse.notes: The reply to adminRequest, to the requesting socket only (requestId and action echoed). failure: forbidden = not an admin right now (the one uniform refusal for every action and target: no account information), invalid = bad args or a wrong typed confirmation, not_found / refused / last_admin / stale_plan (the merge changed since its preview: preview again) / server; message is for the admin. createResetLink.token is the one-time link secret (/reset#<token>): shown to the admin once, never logged or audited. planMerge.plan is formatPlan's content as data (no picture bytes); planHash fingerprints the whole plan and applyMerge applies only when a fresh plan has the same hash. listPlayers: every account newest first, at most `limit` (500) rows; `total` is the true count (the panel says when the list is capped). deleteAccount: kind 'account' = the player's own deletion (server/admin/accountDelete.js; counts of what changed), 'tombstone' = only that merged / renamed name was removed (mergedInto names the account it pointed at, which is unchanged). renameAccount: username is the old name, newName the new; every saved session was revoked (the player signs in once with the new name); the old name became a redirect (oldNameKept; mergedInto + renamedAt, so sign-in with the old name and the account's password says "This account is now called X"; nobody else is told the new name); resumed = a second rename with the same names finished a partial one (also when the redirect was never written: oldNameKept then says whether it is now); a player row's renamed = that redirect, renameUnfinished = on a live account, the old name of its rename that stopped partway (the panel's Finish rename sends renameAccount {username: old, newName: the row}); an admin cannot rename their own account (refused). applyMerge / deleteAccount / renameAccount wait in one queue and are authorized again when their turn comes (forbidden if the admin lost the flag or was signed out meanwhile). The iOS app has no handler (layout: excluded from Swift).

voiceOffer.notes: username is the server-side name of the sender; absent if the sender is not signed in.

voiceRelayAudio.notes: The web PCM fallback, replaced by TURN (2026-11-11): no current client listens. Still forwarded between two web bundles cached before that deploy; removal is V1_REMOVALS #20.

voicePeerLeft.notes: room: a game seat owner dropped (game.broadcast); private: lobby peers (io.to(socketId)).

voiceIceServers.notes: The reply to getVoiceIceServers. iceServers is an RTCPeerConnection iceServers list: turn true = Cloudflare TURN (username / credential on the turn: / turns: entry, valid expiresInSec more seconds; port-53 URLs dropped), false = the public STUN servers both clients used before (expiresInSec null). requestId echoes the request's. Never the API token.

serverShutdown.notes: No listener in either client today (V1_REMOVALS #17).

error.notes: App-level event (not the transport's error). iOS receives it through Socket.IO-Client-Swift's clientEvent .error (the reserved name) and, since 0fd6ef1, shows message as a toast. variant validation is dead today (validators.withValidation has no caller). Rename to serverError is V1_REMOVALS #1. The admin panel's api (adminApi.js) reads {type:'rateLimit', handler:'adminRequest'} to fail a dropped admin request fast as rate_limited.
